name: new-project
title_zh: 从一句想法到 ~/dev 里的项目骨架
tagline_zh: 想法记在 backlog 里三个月也没动，多半是第一步太碎：建目录、开 vault、抄模板。它把这条链路一次走完。
tagline_en: Ideas rot in the backlog because step one is a dozen small chores. This walks the whole chain at once — and.
desc_en: Scaffold a new project under ~/dev following the AI-native SDLC playbook — creates the Obsidian vault design folder and later the repo docs skeleton, via the shared template. Use when the user wants to start, create, scaffold, or set up a new project, app, or idea; or asks to promote an idea from their Project Ideas backlog into a real project.
why_zh: 不是生成一堆空文件，而是按 AI-native SDLC 的顺序落位：先出 Obsidian 设计夹。
why_en: Not a pile of empty files: it lays things down in AI-native SDLC order — Obsidian design folder first, repo docs skeleton after.
limit_zh: 只认 ~/dev 这个根目录，项目不落在那儿它不干；产出到文档骨架为止，不写业务代码、不初始化 git remote。
limit_en: Only works under ~/dev — projects elsewhere are refused. Stops at the docs skeleton: no business code, no git remote, no dependency install.
title_en: Turn one idea into a ~/dev project skeleton, Obsidian.
